purpose: Supplementary ranking utility at frozen lambda=64; not another response-strength search, not privacy verification and not FinalTest authorization.
provenance: Existing Development data and seeds have been used before. No claim of a fresh untouched holdout. Raw ratings are read for established train/Development lineage reconstruction, but the FinalTest slice is not materialized and processed test/prediction files are forbidden.
candidates: Per user use every eligible rating>=4 Dev-Select item, plus 100 deterministic SHA256-ordered previously unobserved items sampled without replacement from the pre-Development observed catalogue. Exclude all interactions known through Development end from the negative pool, including Dev-Fit and nonselected positives. Never consult future FinalTest interactions. All candidate prompts use the same pre-Development last-10 history. No-positive users are excluded with explicit coverage; do not impute zero or silently drop requested users.
interpretation: Unobserved sampled candidates have assumed zero relevance, not verified dislike. Sampled NDCG is not full-catalogue NDCG and should not be compared directly to papers using different candidate protocols. Ranking utility does not prove privacy deletion. No ranking threshold selects lambda or authorizes FinalTest.
fairness: Same candidate identities, prompt histories, K values, scoring and tie rule for all seeds, scenarios and methods. Retain fixed Stage7/9 baselines and P5 references; SISA remains no eligible candidate. Report BOTA64 and BOTA1, with all adverse results retained.
execution: No optimizer/backward/HVP calls. Atomic per-endpoint publication, complete-score retention and CPU metric recomputation. Code, data, selection and checkpoint hashes bind reuse. Failures keep diagnostics; no rescue tuning, candidate substitution or overwrite.
